name: cli
description_en: Command-line tool to customize Spotify client. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
readme_excerpt: Command-line tool to customize the official Spotify client. Supports Windows, MacOS and Linux. Features - Change colors across the User Interface - Inject CSS for advanced customization - Inject Extensions to extend functionalities, manipulate UI and control player - Inject Custom Apps - Make yourself in control of the Spotify client Links - Installation - Basic Usage Code Signing Policy Free code signing provided by SignPath.io, certificate by SignPath Foundation.
